plugin.name: GTA III Definitive Edition Fusion Fix
SkipMenu.description: Resume the selected save once the frontend is ready. Restart required.
SaveSlot.description: One-based slot used by startup resume and quicksave. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiply the gameplay camera field of view; larger is wider. Cutscenes, scripted cameras and zoom views keep the game's own field of view.
HudScale.description: Scale the player information widget. Restart required.
RadarScale.description: Scale the radar widget. Restart required.
DisableFirstPersonAimForRifles.descripti: Disable first-person aiming for rifles. Restart required.
RestoreOriginalCamera.description: Restore the original camera behaviour. Restart required.
ImproveCameraPC.description: Apply PC camera controls and behaviour improvements. Restart required.
CenteringDelay.description: Delay in seconds before camera recentering. Restart required.
RawMouseInput.description: Use raw mouse input for camera controls. Restart required.
VisualStyle.description: 0: Definitive Edition; 1: PS2 colour adaptation; 2: PC colour adaptation. Native tonemapping and HDR remain active. Restart required.
RestoreWeatherColours.description: Restore original weather colours with the selected classic colour adaptation. Restart required.
ColourFilterStrength.description: Strength of the classic colour adaptation, from zero to one. Restart required.
ClassicLODsOnly.description: Keep regular maps and original object LODs resident. This can increase memory use and streaming cost. Restart required.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the mouse in the game window during mouse gameplay. Release it in menus or while unfocused.
TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix settings; Auto follows the system.
